wiki.candycraftmod.alchemy.body: Use the alchemy table with water, caramel, grenadine, liquid chocolate, or liquid candy. Add ingredients and an alchemy mixer blade to brew special candy items such as sugar pills.
wiki.candycraftmod.alchemy.title: Mixing Pot
wiki.candycraftmod.dragon_egg.body: Place the egg on a solid block and surround it with sugar essence flowers in a 5x5 ring. When the ring is complete, the egg hatches like the classic version and turns the flowers into fraise tagada flowers.
wiki.candycraftmod.dragon_egg.title: Blueberry Dragon Egg
wiki.candycraftmod.dungeon_keys.body: Dungeon keys open generated dungeon portals. Inside Jelly Dungeons, sentry and boss keys unlock key blocks. Unlocking the boss key block marks the dungeon as cleared for that instance.
wiki.candycraftmod.dungeon_keys.title: Dungeon Keys
wiki.candycraftmod.emblems.body: Emblems are special accessories. They grant effects such as safer chewing gum walking, reduced fall damage, water healing, or dungeon utility. Store them in the emblem slots when available.
wiki.candycraftmod.emblems.title: Emblems
wiki.candycraftmod.fork.body: The fork is both a weapon and a tasting tool. Tap to eat edible candy blocks. Sneak-right-click to spear a block above you, then hold use to throw the carried block.
wiki.candycraftmod.fork.title: Fork
wiki.candycraftmod.jelly_queen.body: The Jelly Queen guards the Jelly Dungeon route. Defeat her, use the boss key, and claim the dark marshmallow chest in the treasure room.
wiki.candycraftmod.jelly_queen.title: Jelly Queen
wiki.candycraftmod.portal.body: Build a sugar block frame with an empty inside, then right-click the frame with lava, caramel, flint and steel, or liquid candy. The portal sends you to Candy World and drops you from high altitude with resistance.
wiki.candycraftmod.portal.title: Candy World Portal
wiki.candycraftmod.suguard_boss.body: The Suguard Dungeon boss is unfinished, but its emblem and dungeon pieces are already documented here so players know it is future dungeon content.
wiki.candycraftmod.suguard_boss.title: Suguard Totem
